candidates.summary: The cache line's fixed 20x iterations put CacheStoreGetKeyFound/NoKeyFound (50-400 ns ops) behind 1-8 us of timed work, so noise alone crosses the 20% floor and fails PRs that changed nothing
candidates.failure_scenario: Any PR touching Go under gnovm/, tm2/ or gno.land/ runs the cache line at -benchtime 20x. In the PR's own CI run 42262327632 those rows read +-66%/+-141% (KeyFound) and +-20%/+-37% (NoKeyFound). Whenever Mann-Whitney hits p<0.05 by chance (about 2.5% per row one-sided under iid noise), the median gap on such wide samples is far above +20%, so check.sh exits 1. Local A/A (same tree both sides, run.sh + check.sh verbatim) went red 5 times in 460 reps with deltas +24.12% to +78.95% (p=0.000-0.043). The PR body's remedy, raising MAX_TIME_REGRESSION, does not cover a +79% noise delta; the 20x count belongs to AccountLoad1000 only.

candidates.summary: check.sh drops benchstat's '?' delta, so a 0 -> N allocs/op regression passes the alloc gate with p=0.000
candidates.failure_scenario: Benchdata/loop.gno-4 is 0 allocs/op in the PR's own run.
